Will the Undue Influence event use the DragonCon 2005 rules?

An unsanctioned variant format. 3 rounds and a final. All normal
tournament rules apply, except that the time limit is 1 hour per
round, and each player gets an additional 20 transfers on his or her
first turn.

> Will the Undue Influence event use the DragonCon 2005 rules?

No. It'll use the 5+1 rules.

To refresh:

Five transfers by default. (That's the "5" part.)

Standard ramp-up transfers (1 for 1st turn, 2 for 2nd, etc.).

Moving a full minion from uncontrolled to controlled at the end of your
influence phase costs 1 transfer (and is therefore not mandatory). (That's the
"+1" part.)

Drawing a crypt card to your uncontrolled region costs 1 pool and 5 transfers.
(You can also consider this part of the "+1" part.)
